prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a large heavy-boned skeleton standing upright, thick bones of pale bone colour splashed with dark red blood stains, a rusted iron breastplate over the ribs, a skull with two curved horns and burning red eye lights; in every cell it holds exactly two notched curved blades, one in each bony hand, both blades clearly visible and apart from the body: in the idle cell the blade in the hand on the left side of the image is held low and the blade in the hand on the right side of the image is raised toward the heroes; in every cell the whole figure is centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, and its arms and blades stop well before the edges of its cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its horned skull with burning red eye lights is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward toward the heroes, the near arm slashing its blade down in front of the body and the far arm raising its blade high behind the skull, the elbows bent so the blades stay well inside the middle cell; exactly two blades, one in each hand, as in the idle cell, each one solid and clearly drawn, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the horned skull thrown back, both blades flung out to the sides, still one in each hand, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and extend the arms and both blades far from the body. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth, and no slash trail, smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a shield, a loincloth, yellow bones, a single sword, a third blade, a helmet, a cape, blurred or doubled blades.
